manifest.title: Dynastia historical towns — implementation edition
manifest.futurePolicy: Only already-recorded 2027 urban grants; all other post-2026 values held as a game assumption. Queries beyond 2027 reject by default.
manifest.intervalConvention: from inclusive, until exclusive; null until means open within supported range
manifest.annualConvention: Changes use the stated year; 1937 and 1939 Polish pools use their named dated checkpoints. WWII occupation does not by itself replace prewar Polish territorial affiliation; eastern postwar exit is modelled at 1945.
manifest.namePolicy: Polish historical display names / exonyms, with selected substantive renames. Not an exhaustive chronology of foreign official-language names.
manifest.countyRegionPolicy: Fixed reference counties and economic regions; not administrative boundaries reconstructed for every year.
manifest.coordinateSystem: WGS84 longitude/latitude in degrees; GeoJSON stores [longitude, latitude]
manifest.populationPolicy: Dated source observations, undated input, and gameplay estimates are separate. No model number is labelled a census.
manifest.idPolicy: Opaque IDs are minted once and frozen. Legacy migration is lookup-based; never regenerate an ID from a displayed name.
manifest.catalogueScope: 1,748 inherited research identities plus 78 additional historically relevant Commonwealth/fringe centres (52 from v1.2 and 26 added in v1.3). Finite game catalogue, not an exhaustive academic gazetteer of every settlement in the former Commonwealth.
manifest.correctionRelease: v1.3: eastern legal-status audit, multi-anchor major-city populations, Free City of Danzig completion, upper-Dvina region cleanup, successor-identity metadata cleanup, and all 26 previously identified missing places.
